T is the sister-in-law of R. This means T is the other daughter of S (sister of R's wife).

V is the son of Q. (V is Male).

There are only two married couples. One is (P and S) in the 1st generation. The other must be (R and Q) in the 2nd generation, as Q would be the daughter of S and mother of V and U.

Family Structure:



Thus, there are 4 male members: P, R, U, V.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
